in_marathi.name: Subhendu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Near or with good intelligence
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subhendu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Subhendu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘subh’ meaning good, and ‘endu’ meaning intelligence. This name signifies a person who is intelligent and has good judgment. It is a name for a boy who is wise, courageous, and intelligent.
